Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Sponsor credits for Mentor Sprint (July 10-11)

Hi Laura,

Hope you’re well — quick ask from Mentor Circuit. We’re running our Mentor Sprint on July 10-11: an all-remote weekend focused on pairing maintainers with contributors. Expect ~120 participants and ~30 project maintainers. We’d love Redwood to support with promotional credits for maintainers and a short trial extension so new maintainers can onboard without billing friction.

What we’re requesting:
- 100,000 token credit pool to be shared across maintainers (organizer-managed distribution)
- 90-day trial extension for maintainers who sign up during the event

In return we’ll:
- Call Redwood a principal sponsor on the event page and in the kickoff email
- Run one short mention during the opening and put the Redwood logo on the event site

Attached is our sponsor packet and the sprint schedule. We need a yes/no by EOD June 7 to finalize comms. Happy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful.

Thanks — really excited about this one.

Kayla Morales
Partnerships Lead, Mentor Circuit
kayla@mentorcircuit.org

Attachments: mentor_circuit_sponsor_packet.pdf, mentor_sprint_schedule.ics

Looping you in — Kayla asked for 100k tokens + 90-day extensions for maintainers. They want confirmation by next week.

My read: high community visibility, low revenue risk. My suggested compromise if we need to limit exposure: offer 50–75k tokens + 60–90 day extension but require org-level signups for maintainers and one-per-org voucher codes. Can we do tiered voucher issuance (organizer provides list of maintainer emails)?

Also: confirm whether marketing will take the logo placement in-kind or whether they want a paid sponsorship (they indicated primarily promo value).

Thanks Laura — a few clarifying Qs before I sign off:
1) How will the organizer distribute credits? Will they be push to individual emails OR a single org pool?
2) Are maintainers getting dedicated compute (i.e., will they create heavy single-tenant jobs) or just short experiment time? This matters for quantization/throughput planning.
3) Who covers marketing placement — in-kind or paid? If paid, we may want a nominal fee to offset the credit grant.

Suggested offer (pending answers): 75,000 tokens + 90-day extension, but vouchers limited to one per organization and flagged in our portal as "maintainer" for tracking. If marketing co-sponsors the logo placement, we can increase tokens by 25%.

I’ve attached a short process sheet for allocation if you want to run it by Kayla.

— Priyom
